g.text: THE LUNAR SOUTH POLE SHADOW CRISIS
Ultra-low grazing solar elevation (~1.5°) causes crater rims to cast permanent 30+ km freezing shadows.
• Rim blocks Earth line-of-sight & Sun rays
Sun never rises high. Ridges create colossal shadow zones.
A 1,000 m ridge casts a 38 km dark shadow. Batteries freeze at -200°C.
Lander antennas must clear crater rims to keep DSN carrier link active.
